EF001.topic_label: To assess the efficacy and safety of adding tocilizumab to methotrexate versus switching from methotrexate to tocilizumab monotherapy.
EF001.family_label: Tocilizumab plus continued methotrexate (add-on strategy). vs Tocilizumab plus placebo after discontinuing methotrexate (switch strategy/tocilizumab monotherapy). — DAS28–ESR remission (DAS28 <2.6) at week 24.

signature.objective: To assess the efficacy and safety of adding tocilizumab to methotrexate versus switching from methotrexate to tocilizumab monotherapy.
signature.population: Patients with active rheumatoid arthritis and persistent active disease despite methotrexate therapy.
signature.comparator: Tocilizumab plus placebo after discontinuing methotrexate (switch strategy/tocilizumab monotherapy).

EF002.topic_label: Memantine for gait and motor symptoms in advanced Parkinson disease
EF002.family_label: Memantine versus placebo in advanced Parkinson disease with severe gait disorder — change in stride length during on-L-dopa conditions.

signature.objective: To examine the impact of memantine on gait, axial motor symptoms, and L-dopa-induced dyskinesia in advanced Parkinson disease.
signature.population: Patients with Parkinson disease with severe gait disorder and abnormal forward-leaning stance despite optimal L-dopa treatment.
signature.intervention: Memantine titrated for 30 days and then administered at 20 mg daily for 60 days.
signature.primary_outcome: Change in stride length under on-L-dopa conditions.

EF003.topic_label: Immunosuppressive therapy for idiopathic membranous nephropathy with progressive renal dysfunction
EF003.family_label: Prednisolone plus chlorambucil added to supportive therapy versus supportive therapy alone in adults with idiopathic membranous nephropathy and declining renal function — further 20% decline in excretory renal function.

signature.objective: In adults with idiopathic membranous nephropathy and declining renal function, does prednisolone plus chlorambucil added to supportive therapy preserve renal function compared with supportive therapy alone?
signature.population: Adults aged 18–75 years with biopsy-proven idiopathic membranous nephropathy, creatinine less than 300 μmol/L, and documented declining excretory renal function.
signature.intervention: Supportive therapy plus 6 months of prednisolone and chlorambucil.
signature.primary_outcome: Further 20% decline in excretory renal function from baseline.

EF004.topic_label: Immunosuppressive therapy for idiopathic membranous nephropathy with progressive renal dysfunction
EF004.family_label: Ciclosporin added to supportive therapy versus supportive therapy alone in adults with idiopathic membranous nephropathy and declining renal function — further 20% decline in excretory renal function.

signature.objective: In adults with idiopathic membranous nephropathy and declining renal function, does ciclosporin added to supportive therapy preserve renal function compared with supportive therapy alone?
signature.population: Adults aged 18–75 years with biopsy-proven idiopathic membranous nephropathy, creatinine less than 300 μmol/L, and documented declining excretory renal function.
signature.intervention: Supportive therapy plus 12 months of ciclosporin.
signature.primary_outcome: Further 20% decline in excretory renal function from baseline.

EF005.topic_label: Monitoring strategies for antiretroviral therapy in children with HIV
EF005.family_label: Clinically driven monitoring versus routine laboratory plus clinical monitoring in previously untreated children and adolescents with HIV initiating ART — new WHO stage 4 event or death and severe non-HIV-related adverse events.

signature.objective: To evaluate the long-term effect of routine efficacy and toxicity monitoring in African children.
signature.population: Previously untreated children or adolescents aged 3 months to 17 years with HIV meeting WHO 2006 criteria for ART initiation in Uganda and Zimbabwe.
signature.comparator: Routine laboratory plus clinical monitoring for toxicity and efficacy.
signature.primary_outcome: New WHO stage 4 event or death; grade 3 or 4 adverse events not solely related to HIV.

EF006.topic_label: Monitoring strategies for antiretroviral therapy in children with HIV
EF006.family_label: Four-drug induction-maintenance ART followed by three-drug maintenance versus continuous lamivudine, abacavir, and NNRTI in previously untreated African children and adolescents with HIV — change in CD4 percentage and grade 3 or 4 adverse events through weeks 72 and 144.

signature.objective: To evaluate the long-term effect of different first-line ART strategies in African children.
signature.population: Previously untreated children or adolescents aged 3 months to 17 years with HIV meeting WHO 2006 criteria for ART initiation in Uganda and Zimbabwe.
signature.intervention: Induction-maintenance ART: four-drug lamivudine, abacavir, NNRTI, and zidovudine for 36 weeks, followed by either lamivudine, abacavir, plus NNRTI (group B) or lamivudine, abacavir, plus zidovudine (group C).
signature.comparator: Continuous lamivudine, abacavir, plus NNRTI (group A control).
signature.primary_outcome: Change in CD4 percentage from randomisation to weeks 72 and 144; grade 3 or 4 adverse events.

EF007.topic_label: To assess the efficacy and safety of adding tocilizumab to methotrexate versus switching from methotrexate to tocilizumab monotherapy.
EF007.family_label: Tocilizumab plus methotrexate versus placebo plus methotrexate in methotrexate-inadequate-response rheumatoid arthritis — change in pulse-wave velocity and small LDL particle number at 12 weeks.

signature.objective: To assess the effect of tocilizumab on vascular risk surrogates, specifically PWV and small LDL particle number.
signature.population: Adults with moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis with inadequate response to stable methotrexate therapy.
signature.intervention: Intravenous tocilizumab 8 mg/kg every 4 weeks plus oral methotrexate.
signature.primary_outcome: Change at 12 weeks in PWV and small LDL particle number assessed by nuclear magnetic resonance.

EF008.topic_label: To assess the efficacy and safety of adding tocilizumab to methotrexate versus switching from methotrexate to tocilizumab monotherapy.
EF008.family_label: Intravenous tocilizumab plus methotrexate versus placebo plus methotrexate in methotrexate-naive early rheumatoid arthritis — DAS28-ESR remission at week 24.

signature.objective: To evaluate the clinical and radiographic efficacy and safety of TCZ in early rheumatoid arthritis.
signature.population: Adults with moderate-to-severe active early rheumatoid arthritis (duration no more than 2 years) who had not previously received MTX or biologic agents.
signature.intervention: 8 mg/kg intravenous TCZ every 4 weeks plus MTX.

EF009.topic_label: To assess the efficacy and safety of adding tocilizumab to methotrexate versus switching from methotrexate to tocilizumab monotherapy.
EF009.family_label: Intravenous tocilizumab 4 mg/kg plus methotrexate versus placebo plus methotrexate in methotrexate-naive early rheumatoid arthritis — DAS28-ESR remission at week 24.

signature.objective: To evaluate the clinical and radiographic efficacy and safety of TCZ in early rheumatoid arthritis.
signature.population: Adults with moderate-to-severe active early rheumatoid arthritis (duration no more than 2 years) who had not previously received MTX or biologic agents.
signature.intervention: 4 mg/kg intravenous TCZ every 4 weeks plus MTX.

EF010.topic_label: To assess the efficacy and safety of adding tocilizumab to methotrexate versus switching from methotrexate to tocilizumab monotherapy.
EF010.family_label: Intravenous tocilizumab monotherapy versus placebo plus methotrexate in methotrexate-naive early rheumatoid arthritis — DAS28-ESR remission at week 24.

signature.objective: To evaluate the clinical and radiographic efficacy and safety of TCZ in early rheumatoid arthritis.
signature.population: Adults with moderate-to-severe active early rheumatoid arthritis (duration no more than 2 years) who had not previously received MTX or biologic agents.
signature.intervention: 8 mg/kg intravenous TCZ every 4 weeks plus placebo (TCZ monotherapy).

EF011.topic_label: To assess the efficacy and safety of adding tocilizumab to methotrexate versus switching from methotrexate to tocilizumab monotherapy.
EF011.family_label: Subcutaneous tocilizumab 162 mg every other week versus subcutaneous placebo in DMARD-inadequate-response moderate-to-severe rheumatoid arthritis — ACR20 response at week 24.

signature.objective: To characterize the efficacy and safety of subcutaneous tocilizumab 162 mg every other week versus placebo in adults with moderate to severe rheumatoid arthritis with inadequate response to at least 1 DMARD.
signature.population: Adults with moderate to severe rheumatoid arthritis and inadequate response to at least 1 DMARD.
signature.intervention: Subcutaneous tocilizumab 162 mg every other week.

EF012.topic_label: To assess the efficacy and safety of adding tocilizumab to methotrexate versus switching from methotrexate to tocilizumab monotherapy.
EF012.family_label: Intravenous tocilizumab 8 mg/kg or 4 mg/kg plus methotrexate versus placebo plus methotrexate in TNF-antagonist-inadequate-response rheumatoid arthritis — ACR20 response at week 24.

signature.objective: To assess the efficacy and safety of tocilizumab plus methotrexate after failure of at least one TNF antagonist.
signature.population: Adults with moderate-to-severe active rheumatoid arthritis and prior inadequate response or intolerance to one or more TNF antagonists, receiving stable methotrexate.
signature.intervention: Tocilizumab 8 mg/kg or 4 mg/kg intravenously every 4 weeks plus methotrexate.
signature.comparator: Placebo intravenously every 4 weeks plus methotrexate.

EF013.topic_label: Etanercept for platelet activation after acute myocardial infarction
EF013.family_label: Intravenous etanercept 10 mg versus intravenous saline placebo in patients with recent acute myocardial infarction — platelet-monocyte aggregate.

signature.objective: To assess the effects of etanercept on platelet activation, including the primary outcome of platelet-monocyte aggregate, in recent acute myocardial infarction.
signature.population: Patients with recent acute myocardial infarction meeting clinical, ECG, and troponin-I inclusion criteria.

EF014.topic_label: Intensive versus standard blood-pressure targets for secondary prevention after stroke or transient ischemic attack
EF014.family_label: Intensive systolic blood-pressure target below 130 mm Hg (or 10 mm Hg reduction for baseline 125–140 mm Hg) versus standard target below 140 mm Hg in primary-care patients after stroke or TIA — change in systolic blood pressure at one year.

signature.objective: Determine whether a more intensive blood-pressure target in primary care after stroke or TIA leads to lower blood pressure.
signature.population: Patients on general-practice TIA/stroke registers in England.
signature.intervention: Intensive systolic blood-pressure target below 130 mm Hg, or a 10 mm Hg reduction for baseline systolic blood pressure 125-140 mm Hg.
signature.comparator: Standard systolic blood-pressure target below 140 mm Hg.
signature.primary_outcome: Change in systolic blood pressure between baseline and one year.
